metadata.title: Broadcom Stock Pops on Upgrade. Why It’s the Big Anthropic IPO Winner.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Broadcom Is the Big Anthropic IPO Winner. The Stock Pops on Upgrade.
Broadcom stock has had a rough couple of months. But Anthropic’s initial public offering could help kick-start a rally for the chip designer as analysts welcome the details of a $63 billion deal between the two companies.
